scripts.types: pnpm types:www && pnpm types:docs && pnpm types:blog
scripts.types:check: pnpm types:check:www && pnpm types:check:docs && pnpm types:check:blog
scripts.types:www: pnpm exec wrangler types --config apps/www/wrangler.jsonc apps/www/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.types:docs: pnpm exec wrangler types --config apps/docs/wrangler.jsonc apps/docs/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.types:blog: pnpm exec wrangler types --config apps/blog/wrangler.jsonc apps/blog/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.types:check:www: pnpm exec wrangler types --config apps/www/wrangler.jsonc --check apps/www/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.types:check:docs: pnpm exec wrangler types --config apps/docs/wrangler.jsonc --check apps/docs/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.types:check:blog: pnpm exec wrangler types --config apps/blog/wrangler.jsonc --check apps/blog/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.deploy: pnpm deploy:www && pnpm deploy:docs && pnpm deploy:blog
scripts.deploy:www: pnpm build:www && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --config apps/www/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:docs: pnpm build:docs && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --config apps/docs/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:blog: pnpm build:blog && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --config apps/blog/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.versions: pnpm versions:www && pnpm versions:docs && pnpm versions:blog
scripts.versions:www: pnpm exec wrangler versions upload --config apps/www/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.versions:docs: pnpm exec wrangler versions upload --config apps/docs/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.versions:blog: pnpm exec wrangler versions upload --config apps/blog/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.ci: pnpm types:check && pnpm check && pnpm build
